components.label: Base freight per km by billed weight
components.quote: up to and including 500 kg: ₹18.00 per km ... 501 kg to 2,000 kg: ₹24.00 per km

service_levels.quote: Base freight is charged per kilometre of the booked lane distance ... Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

surcharges.label: Express service premium
surcharges.quote: Express service, where booked, carries a premium of 15% of the base freight.

surcharges.label: Fuel surcharge
surcharges.quote: A fuel surcharge of 12% applies to the freight charge (base freight plus express premium, where applicable).

accessorials.label: Residential delivery
accessorials.quote: Residential delivery (consignee address is a residence, or the booking is flagged residential): ₹250.00 flat per consignment.

other_accessorials.quote: No other accessorial charges are payable under this agreement.

credit_notes.quote: The Carrier may issue credit notes correcting earlier invoices.

dispute_window.quote: Billing disputes must be raised within 45 days of invoice date.

non_pricing.summary: Invoicing is fortnightly; payment is due 30 days from invoice date — payment terms, not a pricing rule.
